_comment: Week 7 bonus (W7-Task-Set-C.md Sec.5): 3 scripted 30-turn conversations for scripts/run_conversation_demo.py and scripts/race_long_conversations.py. Turn 1 bundles an incidental personal detail (manager name + office) with the real notice-period question -- realistic phrasing, not flagged as 'remember this'. Turns 2-29 cycle the same 14 generic follow-up questions twice (window_turns=6/fold_batch_size=3 means a fold happens roughly every 3 turns from turn 7 onward, so the turn-1 detail gets compressed almost immediately and then re-compressed 7+ more times by the end). Turn 30 asks the agent to recall the turn-1 detail -- the intended point of failure.
